🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — September 12, 2026

Sun, in Virgo, holds a sextile to Mars, in its fall in Cancer. Nothing in common except the angle they hold: what you hold gets named without shrinking in the telling.

Easier — Letting go of something you had kept out of habit.
Harder — Wide gestures, vague promises, starting on appetite alone.
Backdrop — Jupiter and Saturn hold a month-long trine underneath all of it.

♈ ARIES
Mars governs you, unsupported in Cancer. Moon faces you from Libra, holding the other figures. Cardinal fire: the beginning has a price on it. The square to Saturn that held a week ago has let go.

♉ TAURUS
Venus, your ruler, is in detriment in Scorpio. From Virgo, Sun agrees with you: the easy angle, also the lazy one. Fixed earth: nothing needs letting go of today. The Libra chapter closed four weeks ago.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury, your ruler, moves through Libra unannounced. From Virgo, Sun cuts across the appetite. Air bends, and each bend is invoiced. Mercury left Leo four weeks ago, and the old terms went with it.

♋ CANCER
Moon, your ruler, is only passing through Libra. From Virgo, Sun hands you an opening. Cardinal water: the opening move is the cheap one. A week ago Moon was still held by Venus; that is finished.

♌ LEO
Sun, your ruler, holds no rank in Virgo and simply works. Moon sextiles you from Libra: an opening to be reached for. Fire that holds on, holding without strain. Sun has been out of Leo for four weeks now.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury rules you from Libra, untitled. Sun is in your sign, and distance stops being available. Mutable earth: the alternatives turn out identical. The hold Mars had a week ago is not there any more.

♎ LIBRA
Venus governs you, out of place in Scorpio. Mercury sits inside your sign, and worth stops being an abstraction. Cardinal air: beginning and paying are one act. Moon let go of it a week ago.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars, your ruler, falls in Cancer. Sun sextiles you from Virgo: a door left ajar. Water keeps what it has, cheaply. Mars is 18° further on than in early September, which is barely further on.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter governs you, untitled in Leo. Sun squares you from Virgo, and the cost objects. Fire adapts, and every adaptation has a figure. Four weeks in, and the shape of it is no longer a surprise.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn rules you, fallen in Aries. From Virgo, Sun concedes the point early. Cardinal earth opens the account without argument. It has held four weeks without changing its terms.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn governs you from Aries, where it stands lowest. Moon trines you from Libra, and what you hold finds words unforced. Fixed air holds, and holding asks nothing back. What pressed a week ago has cleared.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter, your ruler, crosses Leo untitled. From Virgo, Sun returns your estimate with corrections. Mutable water: every option kept is an option paid for. The sextile of three weeks ago is off it now.
